question: Lake Baikal, the world's largest freshwater lake (by volume) and the world's deepest lake with a depth of 1620 m (5315 ft), is located in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Lake Baikal**

__
 
• **ancient, massive lake** in** the mountainous Russian region of Siberia, north of the Mongolian border.**
 
• **Volume: 23,620 km³**
 
• holds about **20% **of the** world's fresh surface water.**
 
• one of the **most biodiverse lakes on earth**.
 
• **1340 species of animals (**including **745 species of endemic animals), 570 species of plants (**including** 150 endemics)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Freshwater lakes** hold the majority of **the world’s drinkable water.**
 
• **​Some other largest freshwater lakes are:**
 
 
• **The Caspian Sea** in **Azerbaijan, Iran, Kazakhstan, Russia, and Turkmenistan **and** Depth**: **3,360 ft.**
 
• **Lake Superior **in **Canada and United States **and **Depth:1,333 ft.__**
 
• **Lake Victoria **in **Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Rwanda **and **Depth:__266 ft.__**
